notes.title: Demo Patch - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
A small patch for the demo with some bug fixes:

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug that causes game freezing.
- Fixed a bug that caused Guardian's Shield Burst to do extra damage to self.
- Fixed a bug that caused Party members to die and still visually stay on the field.
- Fixed a bug with swapping primary and secondary jobs letting you keep incompatible equipment.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Now battles don't automatically start when you walk past them on the world map. Instead the game lets you choose to manually start a job, when you walk to a location with a job.

notes.title: Demo Patch - Bug Fixes
notes.content:
A small patch for the demo with some bug fixes and small balance changes:

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
- Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze up after a defeat.
- Fixed an issue with abilities not activating sometime right after selecting them.
- Fixed bug with shop where the number of items you had was not updating right after a purchase.
- Fixed bug in the try and buy menu that would let you try on equipment that your character could not equip.

[h3]Changes[/h3]
- Mage's Firebomb: damage reduced
- Rogue's Sneak Attack: Mana cost reduced from 2 to 1

notes.title: Quality of Life Updates and Controller Support! Demo Version 0.1.12
notes.content:
[h2]Controller Support[/h2]
Spiritlink Tactics can now be played with a controller! Please let me know if your run into any problems using any controllers on the game at the Spiritlink Tactics [url=https://Discord.gg/4ch2QEZbGr]discord[/url].

[h2]Quality of Life Updates[/h2]
Status effects now show up above the character HUD. You can hover over them for a tooltip to see what the effects are! More things will have tooltips added to them in the future for better game clarity.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40321215/b97dbeccbffb76d4ae4fefe2417e74fab0592df5.gif[/img]

Some locations now have the "Patrol" option to look for a battle. You can use "Patrol" as many time as you want to train up your party!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40321215/ecd7644f38fb26daaf9f8518b4da551c5c183296.gif[/img]

Some other updates:
- Can now move the camera around when selecting a target for skills or when selecting where to move a character.
- Can now switch primary and secondary class directly instead of having to select an intermediary class first.
- Can now hover over abilities of locked classes to let players preview what future classes do.
- Most battles will now scale up the level of enemies to match the player's party up to a certain max level.

notes.title: Dialogue Improvements! Demo Patch v0.1.10
notes.content:
[h2]Dialogue Update According to Your Feedback[/h2]

I've gotten a lot of feedback concerning the dialogue and story.  While the plot is fairly set already, the dialogue is still a work-in-process. A lot of it has been rewritten and hopefully improved to give the characters more personality as well as add more exposition to the overall plot. I appreciate everyone who has left feedback, and I hope to continue improving Spiritlink Tactics.

[h2]Other Patch Notes[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]
-AI changed to focus fire less, since having enemies try to kill your frail characters ASAP was unfun.
-Warrior's Challenge: Range 1 -> 2
-Rogue's Cutthroat: Mute duration 1 turn -> 2 turns
-Dagger basic attack: 90 TU -> 80 TU

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
-Fixed bug that sometimes crashed the game at reward screen.

notes.title: Demo Patch 0.1.9
notes.content:
[h2]A Couple Small Improvments![/h2]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
-Weapon descriptions now indicate whether a weapon is a 1-handed or 2-handed weapon.
-New icons on the menu for selecting character move, attack, skill, etc.
-At the rewards screen, added a money bag icon next to the money reward.
-Changed some keybind prompts on the unit screen to be more clear.
-Characters don't show damage taken numbers during cutscenes now, as to not give players unrealistic damage expectations.

[h3]Fixes[/h3]
-Fixed a bug that showed incorrect keybind for removing equipment in the shop's 'try and buy menu'
-Fixed a bug that caused previewing enemy move ranges to not show the correct move range
